description: Agent Coordination: submit a joint progress report from several agents with the plan it reports against: each plan task with the agent the plan gives it to; each progress claim with the task, the agent making it, its status (done, in progress, blocked or not started) and the evidence behind it (a link, a commit, a test run, a file or a record id); and each blocker with its id, the task it blocks, what it is and who is clearing it. The signed report gives every plan task with the agents claiming it and its status (done, in progress, blocked, not started, claimed done twice, disputed or unclaimed), counts the claims, the done claims with evidence and the claims off the plan, lists every blocker as owned or unowned, and names progress that is misreported: tasks claimed done by two agents, plan tasks nobody claims and blockers with no owner; then done claims with no evidence attached, tasks agents report differently, claims off the plan, claims by an agent other than the plan’s owner and tasks reported blocked with no blocker, with the fix for each. A delegate’s duty to report to one principal is wever_delegation-reporting-check, partly done work in one task system is wever_partial-state-check and one run’s trace is wever_observability-trace-check. Verdict progress_misreported, progress_gaps, progress_unverified or progress_accounted. POST /api/coordination-progress-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-coordination-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-coordination/.

claims.description: Each progress claim in the joint report.

evidence.description: What backs the claim: a link, a commit, a test run, a file or a record id.

status.description: Done, in progress, blocked or not started.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

owner.description: The agent the plan gives it to.

task.description: A task id from the plan.
